attempts.name: act1-farm
attempts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Cozy anime RPG inventory PIXEL ART ICON SHEET. Genuine transparent background. NO lettering NO grid NO cast shadow. Each icon centered in equal square cells, entire object visible with ample margins. 1-2 FINAL pixel dark tinted brown outline #302529 #493335, warm top-left cream highlights, chunky readable pixel clusters. Earth ochre olive rust brass palette, magic teal only where specified. Target 32x32 game cells with object occupying 24 pixels, simplify for that size; NOT detailed illustrations. Identity colours silhouette from concept; pixel style outline light and proportions from reference icon atlas. No parchment or labels. One connected object per cell. Row2: stiff ivory QUILLS fan bound at base; angular red COPPER nugget; brass GEAR SPRING with three wide separated coils; low green dish of FROG SLICK; amber HONEY jar. Row3: pale matte WAX blocks; teal GLOW DUST vial; olive VINE ROPE coil with transparent open centre; curved ivory TUSK TIP; folded grey SHED PELT.
